subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>, Lisa Tran <ltran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Lisa,

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your buying committee.

High-level notes:
- Goal: Replace current inference setup for patient-facing summarization workflows with a predictable, low-latency inference stack.
- Decision timeline: aiming for vendor selection and PO by end of June (as discussed).
- Key decision criteria called out in the meeting: p95 latency, per-token economics, private VPC support, SOC2/compliance, and a clear pilot success metric.

Stakeholder map (as understood):
- Economic buyer: Lisa Tran, CFO (final sign-off on budget)
- Procurement / legal: Elaine Morris (procurement contact, not on this thread yet)
- Security / compliance: Daniel Cho, Head of InfoSec (requested SOC2 + data residency details)
- Technical owners: Sanjay (Product Lead) + engineering group (will want a technical workshop)

Attachments: I attached a short SOC2 summary and our standard pricing worksheet for reference (see attachments).

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa / Rishi: Intro to Elaine (procurement) and capture any specific PO terms by EOD Wed 6/3.
2) Technical workshop: Laura to run a focused session for Daniel and the engineering team next week (30-45 min). Laura, what times are you available?
3) Security evidence: We will send SOC2 summary and architecture diagram; Daniel asked about data residency options (we support US regions + private VPC deployments).
4) Pilot scope & metrics: agree on success metric (e.g., 1k daily end-user flows with p95 < 200ms).

If anything above needs correction, please call it out. Happy to update the plan and calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_SOC2_Summary_20260602.pdf, AcmeHealth_MA_Pricing_20260602.pdf

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Tran <ltran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa, helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: looping in Elaine Morris (elaine.morris@acmehealth.com) who handles the PO/contract steps. Elaine, can you confirm standard lead times on our side and any mandatory contract language we should expect?
- Security: I'll introduce Daniel Cho (Head of InfoSec) into the thread, he asked specifically for SOC2 Type II report and a brief architecture diagram showing how data is isolated in private deployments.
- Decision criteria: Lisa emphasized total cost-of-ownership (tokens + infra) and a firm SLA for latency for the pilot. She also wants a clear escalation path for incidents.

Quick answers: pilot budget ~ $30-50k for proof-of-value; aim to have procurement paperwork sorted by the week of 6/22 so we can kick off the pilot early July.

I'll wait for the SOC2 summary and then coordinate with Elaine on contract intake.

Sanjay
Product Lead, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>, Lisa Tran <ltran@acmehealth.com>, Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi all, looping you in, Elaine and Daniel.

Elaine, welcome. Quick note on procurement items we typically see so we can streamline the PO: payment terms (Net 30 is standard), insurance addendum, and a standard SOW/pilot statement of work. We can share sample contract language if that speeds review.

Daniel, attaching a short SOC2 summary (see attachment) and our architecture overview. Key security notes:
- We run customer workloads in dedicated VPCs (no multitenancy at the compute level for Private deployments).
- KMS integration supported for key management; audit logs and access controls available.
- Data residency: we can restrict to US regions; if you need on-prem options we can discuss the Private on-prem package.

Rishi and I captured the stakeholder map and recommended pilot metrics:
- Pilot success: 1k daily summarization flows with p95 latency < 200ms and LLM output quality within agreed eval set (we can share an eval harness).
- Pricing ask: provide 1-month pricing for Pilot (est. token volume included) and committed pricing for Dedicated if the pilot passes.

Laura, can you propose two time slots for the technical workshop (30-45m) next week? Preferably include a short runbook for what we'll validate.

Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa, happy to lead the technical session. Proposed slots:
- Tue 6/9 10:00-10:45am PT
- Wed 6/10 2:00-2:45pm PT

Agenda (30-45m):
1) Architecture & networking: VPC peering, private endpoints, and KMS flow (~10 min)
2) Performance: expected token throughput and latency tuning (batching, KV cache) (~10-15 min)
3) Pilot validation steps: test harness, sample eval prompts, and success criteria (~10 min)
4) Q&A / integration questions (~5-10 min)

What I'll bring to the session: a short runbook to validate p95 latency under expected loads, recommended quantization profiles, and a checklist for production cutover.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmehealth.com>, Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

All, this looks good. We confirmed internally that Tue 6/9 10:00am PT works for Daniel and the engineering team. Elaine, please advise if your team needs any contract templates before that date; otherwise we'll route procurement in parallel.

Action items we agreed on here:
- Redwood: send SOC2 summary + architecture diagram (Marissa) - done (attached).
- Redwood: proposed pilot pricing (Marissa / Rishi) - will send by EOD 6/4.
- Redwood: technical workshop on Tue 6/9 at 10:00am PT (Laura to run).
- Acme: introduce procurement PO process and expected timelines (Elaine).

Goal: have procurement intake started and pricing agreed so PO can be issued by week of 6/22.

Thanks everyone, looking forward to the workshop.

Sanjay
Product Lead, Acme Health
